notes.title: Last Call for Steam's Summer Sale - 30% Off!
notes.notes:
Hello Dealers,

This is your final reminder that the Steam Summer Sale ends in just a few hours, on July 11, 2024, at 6:00 PM (UTC + 0) or 10:00 AM PST. If you haven't yet taken advantage of this special discount on Village Dealer Simulator, now is your last chance! Whether you're eager to dive into village trading or looking for a perfect gift for a friend, this is the best opportunity to get the game at a great price. Don't miss out on this limited-time offer!

As always, we appreciate your support and feedback. Your insights help us improve the game and make it even more enjoyable for everyone. Please feel free to share your thoughts and suggestions in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2844710/discussions/?snr=1_5_9_]Steam discussion forum[/url]. 

Happy trading!
